analysis.insight_summary: A user is moving from one operator panel to another and faces obstacles when trying to interface the Weekly timer block function with their new device. Previously, the user could adjust weekly timer settings (such as days and times) using an older panel but is now unsure how to accomplish this with the current hardware and [product_name] software in the new development environment.
